metric.name: gc_time_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.garbage_collection;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  )
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM frames)
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM android_garbage_collection_events) THEN NULL
    ELSE coalesce((
      SELECT sum(gc_dur) FROM android_garbage_collection_events
      WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
    ), 0) / 1e6
  END AS value

claims.text: App garbage-collection time increased from 258.575876 ms in the baseline trace to 436.083127 ms in the current trace, a delta of 177.507251 ms.

INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT dur AS ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dur) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM frames
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n * 95 + 99) / 100) AS value

claims.text: The correlated range commit increased each Downloads row's vertical padding from 8.dp to 12.dp, which can increase the amount of composed UI and allocation during the exercised screen flow.

caveats: This conclusion is based on one capture per side, so the GC delta may include run-to-run variability.
The current capture was from an emulator (sdk_gphone64_arm64, SDK 36), and the build was a non-debuggable benchmark build.

The trace establishes a GC regression but does not directly connect individual allocations or GC events to the DownloadsScreen change; the commit attribution is therefore correlated rather than direct.
